§6Machine type: §aCircuit Assembler/Gravitation Breaker§r

I never think about the future because it will come sooner or later.
For absolute precision and efficiency, please abandon traditional manufacturing methods.
The machine consists of a ring section and a conveying section.
The number of rings is variable: Maximum 16 rings, Minimum 2 rings(the first and the last).
Total speed multiplier is equal to 400% x num of rings.
Enable Perfect overclock when num of rings >= 8.
128x Parallel per Ring.

[note]Tip[/note] Several TST controllers (Indistinct Tentacle, Deployed Nano Core, Strange Matter Aggregator, Super Water Purifier) are made in the Miracle Top, so it is worth building early in UMV.

[note]Hatches[/note]: Input Bus, Input Hatch, Output Bus, Output Hatch, Energy Hatch
[note]Structure[/note]: the casings in the optional task.
Use a Hologram Projector (or the NEI structure preview) to see and auto-build the structure.

[note]Controller recipe[/note]: Assembly Line, UMV
